business_problem: Hung Fook Tong needed to replace T+1 batch-style retail reporting with real-time operational visibility, customer-behavior analytics, and targeted promotion design across its 100+ store network without disrupting daily sales operations.
solution_summary: Hung Fook Tong modernized its retail network with Tencent Cloud and UXSoft by moving the chain onto a cloud-native stack instead of separate store, inventory, and loyalty systems. UXSoft's cloud-native POS system became the transaction and synchronization layer across 100+ stores, while inventory and membership modules captured stock positions, member activity, and purchase frequency in real time. Tencent Cloud's high-availability infrastructure kept synchronization running across stores, and the integrated retail management center used scalable databases and compute as the brand's control plane. Tencent Cloud Agent Development Platform powered a conversational AI agent that analyzes retail metrics and initiates optimized marketing campaigns instead of relying on static dashboards. The rollout launched POS, inventory, and membership modules together with minimal disruption, giving teams a shared operating fabric for replenishment, segmentation, and omnichannel promotion decisions.

data_flow: Store transactions, inventory movements, and membership activity are captured through the UXSoft cloud-native POS system and synchronized into the integrated retail management center. The inventory and membership modules keep stock and customer-profile data current, and Tencent Cloud Agent Development Platform analyzes these metrics to recommend replenishment actions and launch targeted campaigns across Hung Fook Tong's retail channels.
business_outcome: Hung Fook Tong replaced delayed retail reporting with real-time visibility, gave managers proactive replenishment and promotion tools, and established a cloud-native retail platform that can support deeper AI-driven service and forecasting work across the chain.
